app.name: Itqan Academy
app.description: Student registration, recitation queue, and attendance tracking in one place.

students.title: Join a circle
students.body: Register once with your name and your father's name. After that you join any circle by searching for your name — no account, no password.
students.note: Already registered? Open your circle's link instead.

teachers.title: Run your circles
teachers.body: Sign in to see today's circles, mark attendance, drive the recitation queue, and share your circle's link.
teachers.note: Accounts are created by an administrator.

newStudent.title: New student?
newStudent.body: Register once with your name and your father's name. After that you join any circle by searching for your name.

returningStudent.title: Already registered?
returningStudent.body: Open your circle's link and search for your name to join today's queue. No need to register again.
returningStudent.note: Your teacher shares the circle link with you.

register.title: Register a new student
register.subtitle: You only register once. After that you join any circle by searching for your name.

fields.name: Name
fields.fatherNameHint: Used to tell you apart from similar names.
fields.phoneHint: Only used to reach you if needed.

success.title: Registered
success.body: Welcome, {name}. Your name is now saved permanently.
success.nextStep: Open your circle's link and search for your name to join the queue.

duplicate.title: A matching name is already registered
duplicate.body: If this is you, do not register again — go back to your circle's link and search for your name.
duplicate.hint: Registering twice splits your attendance across two records.

errors.generic: Registration could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: The database is not connected yet.

circle.title: Circle
circle.notToday: This circle is not scheduled to meet today.

search.label: Search for your name
search.placeholder: Type the first two letters of your name
search.hint: At least two letters. Results show the father's name to tell similar names apart.

notFound.title: We could not find your name
notFound.body: If this is your first time, register once and then come back to this page.

joined.title: You are on the list, {name}
joined.position: You are number {position} in the queue.

queue.title: Queue ({count})
queue.empty: Nobody has joined yet. Be the first.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.genderMismatch: You cannot join a circle from a different section.

auth.title: Teacher sign in
auth.subtitle: For teachers and supervisors only. Students never sign in.
auth.studentsNote: Students join their circle from the link their teacher shares — no account needed.
auth.signOutAndSwitch: Sign out and use another account

notLinked.title: This account is not linked to a teacher yet
notLinked.body: You signed in successfully, but no teacher record points at this account. An administrator has to link it before you can manage circles.

inactive.title: This teacher account is deactivated
inactive.body: Your teacher record exists but has been switched off. Ask an administrator to reactivate it.

errors.generic: Sign in could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: The database is not connected yet.

dashboard.title: Teacher dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your circles, today's queue, and attendance.

today.title: Meeting today
today.empty: None of your circles meet today.

new.title: New circle
new.subtitle: The circle repeats on the days you choose, and its link is permanent — share it once.

fields.name: Teacher name
fields.genderHint: Only students of this section can join, and that is enforced in the database itself.
fields.sessionLinkHint: Google Meet, Zoom, or Telegram. Students open it from the circle page.
fields.timezoneHint: The session date is calculated in this timezone, so early-morning circles are recorded on the right day.
fields.slugHint: This permanent link is generated automatically. Copy it to share with your students.

errors.linkInvalid: Enter a full link starting with http:// or https://
errors.timezoneInvalid: The database does not recognise that timezone.
errors.durationInvalid: Duration must be between 5 and 480 minutes.
errors.slugLength: The link must be between 3 and 60 characters.
errors.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
errors.slugTaken: That link is already in use. Choose another.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to create circles.
errors.generic: The circle could not be created. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: The database is not connected yet.

session.title: Circle session
session.notToday: This circle is not scheduled to meet today. You are looking at today's records.

queue.title: Today's queue
queue.hint: Updates live as students join. Reorder with the arrows.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.subtitle: Every circle, every teacher, and the attendance report.

circles.title: All circles
circles.empty: No circles have been created yet.

teachers.title: Teachers and supervisors
teachers.note: Accounts are created in Supabase and linked by hand — see supabase/seed/first-admin.sql.

circleEdit.title: Edit circle
circleEdit.subtitle: Update the circle settings or deactivate it for good.

reports.title: Attendance report
reports.subtitle: Ranking over any date range. Only records marked present count as attendance.
reports.unmarkedWarning: {count} records were never marked by a teacher. They are excluded from the attendance count.

filters.customHint: Used when the period is set to a custom range.

results.title: Students ({count})
results.empty: No attendance records in this range.
results.legend: The three numbers are present, absent, and unmarked, in that order.
